name: Branded workwear & safety-recognition merchandise for Chicago-area trade contractors (promo distributor, supplier-decorated drop-ship)
summary: Founder-sold promotional-products distributorship focused on commercial trade contractors (electrical, plumbing, HVAC/mechanical, mid-size GCs) in Cook/DuPage/Kane/Lake/McHenry. Revenue = first 'crew kit' order per new account plus recurring reorders (new-hire kits, seasonal hi-vis/cold-weather gear, Safety Week/stand-down recognition, online company stores). No inventory; suppliers and contract decorators produce to order. Operating profit is before founder pay.
evidence_notes: Gross margin anchored on 4imprint H1-2026 gross margin 31.5% (B, C9-S015) and ASI's claimed 37% distributor average (C, WS16-S026); new-entrant base set at 31% because a newcomer has no volume rebates and prices against 4imprint's published end-buyer prices (B, DH-S025).

Repeat behaviour anchored on 4imprint: ~81% of H1-2026 orders came from existing customers (838k of 1,040k, our calc; B, DH-S026). Contractor-account annual spend ($7.8k base) and churn are analyst estimates (E).

Small distributors (<$1M sales) were roughly flat in Q2 2026 while >$1M firms grew ~4% (C, C9-S013); 4imprint new-customer orders fell 12% in 2025 (A, C9-S014). These argue against aggressive acquisition assumptions.

Membership/software costs are published: PPAI Standard Base $595/yr incl. 1 SAGE Workplace licence (B, DH-S020); commonsku $129/user/month, minimum 2 users (B, DH-S021). ASI membership price is not published (MISSING; D-level stale figures only, DH-S022).

Supplier credit: SanMar's credit application offers Net 30 or credit card, with credit report, trade references and a personal guaranty (B, DH-S024). New accounts are modelled as mostly card-prepaid (DPO 15 days base).
Customer terms: ASI 2023 survey reports corporate payment terms stretching to 'sometimes 120 days' (C, DH-S028). DSO 40 days base.
Rep economics: ASI 2023 median rep/manager compensation $75k; traditional 50/50 gross-profit split under pressure (C, DH-S028); commonsku estimates outside reps take ~40% of GP (D, DH-S029).
All funnel and volume drivers are E (no contact or test performed). Buyer universe: 1,266 contractors with >=5 Chicago permits of >=$100k reported cost in 2025-26 (A, DH-S031).

STAGE E (2026-11-28) corrections: (1) Stage D transaction prices were not all 'at or below 4imprint': 4imprint's CornerStone ANSI Class 2 tee with back embroidery is $22.50 at 48 / $20.95 at 72 [B, E-WS16006-S001], and its 18-oz laser-engraved tumbler is $12.29 at 144 + $45 setup [B, E-WS16006-S003]; the $19.25-$32.75 and $12.85-$21.35 ranges in DH-S025 were mis-read from search-page layout. (2) Public blank prices (ShirtSpace, 2026-11-28: CS401 ANSI tee $17.54, Gildan G500 colours $2.71, G18500 hoodie $12.30-$13.83, Richardson 112 $9.75) [B as e-tailer price; D as proxy for distributor net, E-WS16006-S004] plus contract decoration [B, DH-S030; C, E-WS16006-S006] imply only ~10-25% gross margin on commodity decorated apparel at 4imprint price parity; ~30% needs prices ~10-20% above 4imprint (still below supplier 'retail' list, e.g. All-Secure G18500 embroidered $33.54 at 48 (R)) [B, E-WS16006-S006]. Base GM cut 31%->30% recurring and 30%->28% first orders; conservative 25%/23%.

STAGE E: industry distributor GM benchmarks are higher than the newcomer base: PPAI reports 2025 GM 34-36% by size band (2024: <$3M firms 34%) [C, E-WS16006-S009, search extract]; Counselor 2026 average 'profit margin' 37.1% (37.8% prior) [C, E-WS16006-S010]; ~90% of distributors raised prices in 2025 by ~11% avg [C, E-WS16006-S011]. These are established-firm averages with rebates and hard-goods mix (incumbent economics).

STAGE E: tariffs - IEEPA duties ended 2026-02-20 [A, WS16-S022]; Section 122 10% (raised to 15% per one firm) global duty 2026-02-24 to 2026-07-24, CAFTA-DR textiles exempt [C, E-WS16006-S013]; Section 301 'forced-labor' tariffs of 10% or 12.5% on 60 economies (99.4% of imports) from July 2026 [A, E-WS16006-S012]. MFN duties: man-made-fibre knit tees 32%, cotton tees 16.5%, CAFTA-DR origin free [A, E-WS16006-S014]. Pass-through risk is captured by the GM -5/-10 pt stress tests.

STAGE E: recurring demand - BLS JOLTS construction hires rate averaged ~4.2%/month Jan-Sep 2026 (~50%/yr) [A, E-WS16006-S015], supporting new-hire kit recurrence; OSHA requires employer-paid PPE but not everyday/weather clothing [A, E-WS16006-S016], so branded hoodies/jackets are discretionary.

STAGE E: sales rep now hired only when monthly revenue >= $60k (policy gate from the playbook), not unconditionally in month 25; the Stage D month-25 hire made the conservative case lose money for 3 years (peak funding $329k), which the playbook explicitly forbids. The ungated hire is kept as a pre-mortem case.
STAGE E standardization: founder draw $4,000/month from month 13 in all scenarios; tax 30%; start capital = smallest injection keeping base cash >= 0; long-term drivers evidenced below.

drivers.sales_start_delay_months__source: LLC + IDOR REG-1 registration (A, WS16-S036); PPAI join is online at $595/yr (B, DH-S020); supplier accounts need an industry number + resale certificate/credit app (C, DH-S023). 2-6 weeks (E).
drivers.sales_cycle_months__source: Stage A/C: orders 1-4 weeks, programs 1-3 months (E). First order usually follows a mockup/quote.
drivers.founder_ramp_months__source: Analyst estimate: list-building from permit data, sample kit, first referrals.
drivers.founder_leads_per_month__source: Qualified conversations with contractor ops/safety/office managers from ~15-20 hrs/week outbound + association events (MCA Chicago, ECA Chicago, Chicagoland AGC). Universe 1,266 permit-active contractors in Chicago alone (A, DH-S031).
drivers.lead_to_proposal_pct__source: Analyst estimate: share of qualified conversations that request a quote/mockup.
drivers.proposal_to_win_pct__source: Analyst estimate; incumbents (local shops, 4imprint, contractor's existing supplier) are entrenched; to be tested in validation experiment V2.
drivers.rep_new_customers_per_month__source: Analyst estimate for one experienced industry rep; ASI 2023 notes 35% of reps on straight commission (C, DH-S028).
drivers.referral_new_per_100_active__source: Analyst estimate: GC-to-sub and union-local word of mouth.
drivers.monthly_churn_pct__source: 26%/yr base account loss; 4imprint reports ~81% of orders from existing customers and 'strong and consistent retention' (B, DH-S026; C9-S014) - incumbent, so new-entrant churn set higher.
drivers.arpc_monthly__source: Active account reorders 4-8x/yr at ~$1,000-1,500 (=$5.4k-10.2k/yr). 4imprint AOV ~$654 (A, C9-S014, our calc) is a small-order floor; contractor orders are larger (crew quantities).
drivers.onetime_revenue_per_new_customer__source: First 'crew kit' order - see transaction T1 ($3,285) priced inside 4imprint published ranges (B, DH-S025); conservative assumes smaller trial orders.
drivers.arpc_annual_growth_pct__source: 4imprint AOV +3% in H1-2026 via price adjustments (B, DH-S026); tariff pass-through.
drivers.gross_margin_pct__source: Newcomer blended GM on contractor reorders. Incumbent anchors: 4imprint H1-2026 31.5% (B, C9-S015); PPAI 2025 34-36% by size band (C, E-WS16006-S009); Counselor 37.1% avg (C, E-WS16006-S010). Newcomer basket test at public blank/decoration prices: ~10-25% at 4imprint price parity, ~30% at +10-20% (B/D, E-WS16006-S001..S006). Conservative = 4imprint-parity pricing with tariff pass-through lag.
drivers.onetime_gross_margin_pct__source: First 'crew kit' orders priced to win against the incumbent local shop / 4imprint (see T1 basket: 24.8% at near-4imprint prices, 30% at ~+10%) (B/D/E, E-WS16006-S001..S006).
drivers.variable_opex_pct_revenue__source: Card processing on ~half of revenue (~1.5%), unrecovered freight, reprints/misprints (~1-2%; contract decorators disclaim errors on customer files/defective goods, E-WS16006-S006); commonsku shop fee 2.5%->1% (B, DH-S021). Conservative adds a higher reprint rate.
drivers.cac_per_new_customer__source: Spec samples, mockups, site visits, lunch-and-learns.
drivers.fixed_marketing_per_month__source: LinkedIn/CRM data, website, sample library refresh, association event fees.
drivers.dso_days__source: Net-30 contractor AP with slow payers; ASI 2023 reports terms 'sometimes 120 days' (C, DH-S028); deposits on first orders offset.
drivers.inventory_days_cogs__source: Made to order, no inventory (C, WS16-S026); small sample and company-store buffer stock.
drivers.dpo_days__source: SanMar Net 30 only after credit approval incl. personal guaranty, else credit card (B, DH-S024); many suppliers prepay until credit established.
drivers.start_capital_injection__source: Stage E rule: smallest injection (rounded up to $100) keeping base-case cash >= 0 = base peak funding need incl. $4k/month draw from m13 ($39,105).
drivers.ev_multiple__source: Founder-relationship promo book sold on earn-out; no completed-transaction multiple found (MISSING; BizBuySell/IBBA pages not retrievable 2026-11-28). Adjacent Atlas anchor: small insurance books 5-7x profit (C, C5-S021) are far stickier, so promo is set well below. Applied to operating profit before owner pay (SDE-like).
drivers.founder_draw_per_month__source: Stage E standardization rule: $4,000/month living stipend from month 13 in all scenarios.
drivers.lt_growth_y6_pct__source: Industry sales growth +1.3% (PPAI 2025, C, E-WS16006-S008), +4.2% (ASI 2025, C, C9-S012), +2.5% Q2-2026 (C, C9-S013); small (<$1M) distributors flat (C, C9-S013). Base 8% assumes continued rep/account additions in year 6; conservative ~ nominal industry growth.
drivers.lt_growth_decay__source: Growth fades as the Chicago trade-contractor cluster saturates (1,266 permit-active contractors, A, DH-S031); conservative fades fastest.
drivers.incremental_roic_pct__source: Growth capital is mostly receivables (DSO 40 d vs DPO 15 d => NWC ~8% of revenue, model) plus rep ramp losses; at ~10-12% operating margin the pre-tax return on incremental NWC is ~1.2-1.4x before rep ramp costs; base haircut to 0.6, conservative 0.35 (slow-paying GCs, ASI terms 'sometimes 120 days', C, DH-S028).
drivers.maint_capex_pct_op__source: Asset-light: laptops, sample library, vehicle share; no production equipment (suppliers/contract decorators produce).
drivers.reserve_months__source: Cash reserve vs cyclical construction customers and slow receivables (recession stress takes base y3 op to ~0 in Stage D); conservative holds 3 months of cash costs.

staff.role: Account coordinator (order entry, proofs, supplier follow-up, store admin)
staff.notes: ~$48k salary + burden (E). One coordinator per ~$70k/month of sales (E). Stage E: max_count raised 3->6 so optimistic-case staffing scales with revenue (1 per ~$70k/month).

Hired only once monthly revenue >= $60k (founder + coordinators at capacity; playbook gate: founder sustains >=3 new accounts/month at >=30% GM). ASI 2023 median rep/manager comp $75k (C, DH-S028); reps commonly take ~40-50% of GP (D, DH-S029) - modelled as fixed loaded cost (conservative for downside). Stage D hired one unconditionally in month 25 (Correction).

transactions.notes: Sell: tee $8.25 (4imprint $7.25 at 72 / $6.25 at 144), hoodie $26.50 (4imprint $25.75 at 24 / $22.50 at 48), cap $18.50 (4imprint $18.95 at 24 / $15.50 at 48) [B, E-WS16006-S001/S002]. 150 Gildan G500 tees: blank $2.95 + print ~$1.25 + screen $20 + freight $0.35

transactions.notes: Sell: tumbler $13.50 + $45 setup passed through (4imprint $12.29 at 144 + $45) and tee $7.25 (4imprint $6.25 at 144) [B, E-WS16006-S001/S003]. Contribution ~$910 (29%). Tumbler supplier net is MISSING (E). Net-30 invoice; supplier card-paid at PO -> ~45-day float.

transactions.notes: Recurring program; contribution ~$480/month (24%). Store fee schedule (B, DH-S021); OMG/BrightStores company-store hosting reported at $119/month Standard (D, E-WS16006-S017) as alternative.
